analysis: The code snippet calls JOptionPane.showInputDialog(null, message). The API documentation declares only HeadlessException. The context does not include any try-catch blocks or conditional checks for a headless environment. The method is called unconditionally. Therefore, the HeadlessException is not avoided.
remark: The HeadlessException is thrown when the Java runtime environment does not support a display, keyboard, or mouse (i.e., GraphicsEnvironment.isHeadless() returns true). The code snippet does not check this condition before calling showInputDialog, so if the application runs in a headless environment, the exception will be thrown.
